posts.text: This stock sounds interesting. Even now, only two companies have the Ministry of Defence (MoD) approval to supply bulb bars for Navy-related shipbuilding. Bulb bars are approximately 10-15% of a ship’s tonnage. The average selling price of Bulb bars is in the range of INR 5 - 6 Lakh per tonne. This is the 1st company to do bulb bars in India. Before that, they were imported from Russia. Krishna Defence has been doing this since 2006. IN 2014, the MoD awarded them for indigenisation.
